Diana|mid.identity: Magic damage fighter-assassin. Crescent Strike (Q) applies Moonlight, which resets Lunar Rush (E); Pale Cascade (W) protects her with orbs; her passive hits in an area every three attacks; and Moonfall (R) pulls in every nearby enemy before an explosion that hurts more for each champion hit.
Diana|mid.playstyle: Burst and roaming mid. She punishes mages and melee assassins, and roams very well after level 6.
Diana|mid.early_game: Farm with Q and your passive, poke with Q when your opponent comes to last hit. At level 3, Q → E → W → attacks is a very strong all-in against mages. Keep W to soak poke.
Diana|mid.level_2: Lunar Rush (E) or Pale Cascade (W) depending on your order. Q → E: dash onto the marked target.
Diana|mid.level_3: Full kit: Q → E → W → attacks (passive). A big all-in against mages with no escape.
Diana|mid.level_6: Moonfall: combo Q → E → R → E (reset if Q marked) → W. You can kill most mages and roam to the side lanes.
power_spikes: First completed item: burst or durability depending on your build.
Mid game: multi-target engages in teamfights.
Diana|mid.lane_plan: Farm with Q and your passive, all-in when your opponent has used their CC or escape. After level 6, push the wave and roam. The mid role quest (faster recall) makes these trips worthwhile.
Diana|mid.trading: Short trade: Q poke. Full trade: Q → E → W → attacks. All-in: Q → E → R → E → W. Engage when the enemy CC is on cooldown; give up on it if your Q missed.
threats: Mid Nasus and tanks who soak your burst.
CC mages who stop you mid-engage.
mistakes: Using E without a Q mark.
Engaging without your ultimate against a mage who has their CC ready.
Staying in lane instead of roaming after level 6.

matchup_notes.Zed: W absorbs his shurikens; engage once he's used his shadow.
matchup_notes.Katarina: Your ultimate interrupts her Death Lotus by pulling her in.
matchup_notes.Viktor: Engage when his Gravity Field is on cooldown.
matchup_notes.Ahri: Engage when her Charm is on cooldown.
matchup_notes.Yasuo: His Wind Wall blocks your Q: wait until he's used it.

Diana|mid.mid_game: Roams, picks and teamfights. Diana is strong when she can hit several targets with her ultimate.
Diana|mid.late_game: Flank engage: Q on the closest target, E to go in, R in the middle of several enemies.
Diana|mid.ahead: Roam, create advantages across the map and take objectives.
Diana|mid.behind: Farm and play for a decisive ultimate on several targets.
Diana|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to punish mages in lane, roam after 6 and engage teamfights on several targets.
Diana|mid.final_tip: Always cast Q before E: without the mark, you lose your second dash.
